column1: # Results behind the attempt-5 cells (the fifth measurement session; the baseline is from the fourth) of the tierstore paper: one build of one target, komira_sdk_exec, in three arms
# (baseline: kbf's cold store is the HDD MinIO, no tierstore; cold: through the node's tierstore with an empty
# local_cache; warm: the same, the local_cache holding what the cold run filled). One run per arm, so no medians.
# Columns: kind, id, value, unit, how the value was taken, cells. tests/paper.rs reads the id, the value and the cells:
# a number a measured cell prints must be the value of a row whose cells column names that cell. A row that no cell
# quotes has no sixth column. raw: a value as recorded. derived: arithmetic on raw values, named in the fifth column.
# meta: a fact of the setup. The tierstore rows are the difference of the node tierstore's own counters read before
# and after each run. The MinIO rows are the difference of MinIO's cluster-wide GET counter (the per-bucket counter is
# not exposed), so they include any other client of that MinIO during the run.
# tests/paper/attempt5.rs holds every row of this file (id, value and unit, and no other row) and the cells that print
# them to the run's record: change, add or delete a row here and its tests fail until the record there changes too.
